product_title: Royal Pink Lotus Rangoli Tealight Set
product_description: Enhance your festive decor with this elegant rangoli set featuring pink lotus motifs, golden accents, pearl detailing, and decorative tealight holders. Perfect for Diwali celebrations, pooja, and traditional home decor.
product_care_suggestion: Clean gently with a soft, dry cloth.
Keep away from water and harsh chemicals.
Handle decorative pearls and embellishments carefully.
Place on a stable, heat-resistant surface.
Use LED tealights for safer, long-lasting decor.
Store in a dry, protective box after use.
